about: Lichess.org (free open-source chess server): read-only CLI over its server-rendered pages for FIDE player and federation data, broadcast search and calendar, rating leaderboards, online players, and tournament winners and details.

commands.summary: Search or list FIDE-rated players, sortable by name or classical/rapid/blitz rating, paginated 30 per page

params.name: q
params.description: Player name to search for, e.g. 'Kasparov'. Omit to list top players.

params.name: order
params.description: Sort column: name, standard (classical rating), rapid, blitz, or year (age)

commands.summary: List recent broadcast tournaments a FIDE player took part in, newest first, paginated

params.name: slug
params.description: Name slug from the player url, e.g. Kasparov_Garry

commands.summary: List FIDE federations with player counts and average top ratings, paginated 30 per page
Get a FIDE federation's world rank, top-10 average rating and player count for classical, rapid and blitz (one item per category)

params.name: federation
params.description: Federation slug as in /fide/federation/{federation}, e.g. Norway, United_States_of_America, India

commands.summary: List the FIDE players of one federation, sortable by name or rating, paginated 30 per page
Search official live tournament broadcasts by keyword, or list live/upcoming ones when q is omitted, 24 per page

params.name: q
params.description: Search keywords, e.g. 'Norway Chess'. Omit to list live and upcoming broadcasts.

commands.summary: List all broadcast tournaments scheduled in the current month's broadcast calendar
List lichess's top-10 leaderboard for every rating category (bullet, blitz, rapid, classical, variants)
List the strongest lichess players who are online right now, with their rating (username is the last path segment of url)
List recent winners of lichess's recurring arena tournaments (Elite, HyperBullet, Yearly, Monthly, Marathon...) by category
Get a lichess arena tournament's name, format/time control, start time, description and winner profile url

params.name: id
params.description: Tournament id from /tournament/{id}, e.g. yvqavUey or summer26
